# pi-tools decision records

Write a record only for an accepted decision whose explanation remains consequential after implementation. It is historical explanation, not current state. A consequential record may receive risk-based review.

<!-- awf:edit format: default; create .awf/skills/parts/decision-records/format.md to override -->
## Format

Create plain dated-slug Markdown using only:

```markdown
# <date> <slug>
## Context
## Decision
## Consequences
```

State the circumstances, accepted choice, and durable trade-offs. Do not add frontmatter, numbering, status, lifecycle, transaction protocol, or CLI requirement. Update current-state topics separately when represented reality changes.
